description: Source code for the Playwright Recorder, a component that captures user interactions, manages recording modes, handles page events, and communicates with the debugger and other components to facilitate automated testing and recording of browser interactions.

classes.name: Recorder
classes.description: Main class implementing the recording functionality, event handling, page and frame management, and interaction with debugger and other components.

methods.name: forContext
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Recorder instance for a given browser context.

methods.name: existingForContext
methods.description: Retrieves an existing Recorder instance for a given browser context, if any.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate and initialize a Recorder.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Recorder with a browser context and parameters.

methods.name: _install
methods.description: Sets up event listeners, exposes bindings, and prepares the recorder for operation.

methods.name: _pausedStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in debugger paused state, updates call metadata and user sources.

methods.name: mode
methods.description: Returns the current recording mode.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the recording mode and updates UI and debugger state accordingly.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the primary page.

methods.name: setHighlightedSelector
methods.description: Highlights a specific selector in the UI.

methods.name: setHighlightedAriaTemplate
methods.description: Highlights an ARIA template in the UI.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Resumes debugger execution for a single step.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the current language for code generation.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes debugger execution.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses debugger on the next statement.

methods.name: paused
methods.description: Returns whether the debugger is paused.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Resumes debugger, effectively closing the recorder.

methods.name: hideHighlightedSelector
methods.description: Removes selector highlight from UI.

methods.name: pausedSourceId
methods.description: Returns the source ID of the paused location.

methods.name: userSources
methods.description: Returns the list of user sources.

methods.name: callLog
methods.description: Returns the current call log.

methods.name: _scopeHighlightedSelectorToFrame
methods.description: Resolves and scopes the highlighted selector to a specific frame.

methods.name: _refreshOverlay
methods.description: Refreshes overlay visuals on all pages.

methods.name: onBeforeCall
methods.description: Handles logic before a call is executed, updates metadata and highlights.

methods.name: onAfterCall
methods.description: Handles logic after a call is executed, updates metadata and highlights.

methods.name: _updateUserSources
methods.description: Updates the list of user sources based on current call metadata.

methods.name: onBeforeInputAction
methods.description: Placeholder for handling input actions before execution.

methods.name: onCallLog
methods.description: Updates call logs with new call metadata.

methods.name: updateCallLog
methods.description: Updates internal call log state and emits event.

methods.name: _isRecording
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is a recording state.

methods.name: _readSource
methods.description: Reads source code from a file.

methods.name: _setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the recorder.

methods.name: _onPage
methods.description: Handles page creation, navigation, and events.

methods.name: _filePrimaryURLChanged
methods.description: Emits event when primary page URL changes.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the recorder state, especially on navigation.

methods.name: _describeMainFrame
methods.description: Returns description of the main frame.

methods.name: _describeFrame
methods.description: Returns description of a specific frame.

methods.name: _testIdAttributeName
methods.description: Returns the attribute name used for test IDs.

methods.name: _createActionInContext
methods.description: Creates an action context for a frame.

methods.name: _performAction
methods.description: Performs an action within a frame.

methods.name: _recordAction
methods.description: Records an action within a frame.

methods.name: _onFrameNavigated
methods.description: Handles frame navigation events.

methods.name: _onPopup
methods.description: Handles popup window events.

methods.name: _onDownload
methods.description: Handles download events.

methods.name: _onDialog
methods.description: Handles dialog events.
